Drinks Chiller audit (confidence 0.76, compliance 82%) found 2 of 11 planogram SKUs empty:

1) Ragolis Water 75cl - shelf empty, but there are 4 units on hand in the store. Please REFILL THE SHELF TODAY from back stock; no need to wait for delivery. A top-up case of 12 has also been proposed (approx. N2,400) since on-hand 4 is below the reorder point of 6.

2) Coca-Cola 50cl PET - shelf empty AND zero on hand. Nothing to refill with; 2 cases (24 units, approx. N7,200) proposed for delivery.

All other 9 SKUs are at expected facings. No fridge telemetry was available for this store, so cooling could not be checked - please eyeball the chiller temperature on your next visit and report if drinks are not cold.
